content_blocks.title: Teach Me Like I'm 10: Understanding AI Categories for Incident Management

content.text:
Okay, let's make this super simple.

Understanding AI Categories for Incident Management is basically about ai definition.

- **What to look at** (instead of guessing)
- **What to do next** (instead of panicking)
